title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Purple Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Purple Edition Pre Filled Pods offer two multi-layered berry fusions for the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod blends Strawberry, Raspberry and Cherry with an icy twist, while the other brings Blueberry and Raspberry together with zesty Lemonade for a bright citrus edge. Both pods are Pre Filled with 2ml of e-liquid and feature 5ml refill chambers for extended use through the device automatic refill system. With their bold berry blends and cool citrus lift, Purple Edition brings vivid flavour and contrast in every puff. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
